SOURCE & METHOD

Summaries from chapters, not titles.

Each chapter summary is condensed from the chapter conclusion and chapter structure in the user-supplied bilingual manuscripts. Maithili and English records are taken from their respective source texts; no chapter is summarized from its title alone.
